title: 经济学家：AI变革下，人民币升值天花板为何被压低？
speaker: Unknown

segments.en: Number two is your question on exchange rate. Right now, it's around 6.7 to 1 US dollar.
segments.zh: 第二是你关于汇率的问题。目前大约是6.7人民币兑1美元。

segments.en: There are many people calling for a very fast and big appreciation of the MNB. I had a slightly different view because of AI revolution.
segments.zh: 很多人呼吁人民币快速大幅升值。由于AI变革，我的观点略有不同。

segments.en: Because AI revolution is very different. Because it's really happening in the service sector. More importantly, in the non-tradable service sector, such as healthcare, education, delivery.
segments.zh: 因为AI变革非常不同。因为它真正发生在服务业。更重要的是，在不可贸易的服务业，如医疗、教育和配送。

segments.en: This, you know, they can't give you, you know, because it's only domestically sold. So if you have a productivity increase in this sector, if you cannot sell globally, you know, it actually tends to reduce your cost and then also reduce your price.
segments.zh: 这些，你知道，它们无法出口，因为只在国内销售。所以如果这个部门生产率提高，又不能全球销售，实际上往往会降低成本，进而降低价格。

segments.en: So that actually adds a deflation pressure. So in the economic struggle, it's actually the reversal of bothersome effect.
segments.zh: 所以这实际上增加了通缩压力。所以在经济结构中，这实际上是巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应的逆转。

segments.en: The bothersome effect means that many happen in the tradable sector. They have faster productivity growth than the non-tradable sector.
segments.zh: 巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应意味着，许多发生在可贸易部门。它们的生产率增长快于不可贸易部门。

segments.en: Right now, we have the opposite of it. The non-tradable sector is actually growth faster than the tradable sector.
segments.zh: 现在，我们看到了相反的情况。不可贸易部门的增长实际上快于可贸易部门。

segments.en: So I think that we are pushed down the equilibrium exchange rate of the MNB and hence lower the ceiling of the MNB appreciation.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，这压低了人民币的均衡汇率，从而降低了人民币升值的上限。
